items.name: Immediate-then-Eroded
items.mechanism: thesis stated in the first lines; the passage spends itself qualifying it; the final version barely resembles the first

items.name: Decoy First
items.mechanism: a plausible thesis planted early; the real thesis displaces it mid-passage

items.name: Negative Space
items.mechanism: the thesis is never stated; it emerges from the pattern of what the author refuses to accept

items.name: Late Crystallization
items.mechanism: accumulating observations crystallize into a claim only in the penultimate paragraph

items.name: Two-Stage
items.mechanism: half the thesis mid-passage; the second half — the sting — withheld until the end

items.name: Borrowed Mouth
items.mechanism: the thesis first appears in the mouth of a quoted opponent, then is reclaimed and modified

items.name: Question Form
items.mechanism: the thesis appears only as a question; the answer is implied by the structure, never voiced

items.name: Retrospective Reveal
items.mechanism: the final movement reframes everything; the thesis is visible only on a mental re-read

items.name: Progressive Sharpening
items.mechanism: the same claim stated three times with rising precision; the versions differ in what they surrender

items.name: Casual Aside
items.mechanism: the thesis dropped mid-paragraph as if it were a minor observation

items.name: Definitional Smuggle
items.mechanism: the thesis hidden inside how the key term is defined at the outset; recognized as a thesis only late

items.name: Concessive Carrier
items.mechanism: the thesis lives inside a 'granted, ...' clause — the concession is the claim

items.name: Split Thesis
items.mechanism: two half-theses in different paragraphs, never joined; joining them is the reader's job

items.name: Counter-Punch
items.mechanism: the thesis emerges only as the rebuttal to the strongest objection

items.name: Example-Borne
items.mechanism: never abstractly stated; fully embodied in the treatment of one example

items.name: Escalating Denial
items.mechanism: the author repeatedly says what the thesis is NOT; the positive content is the residue

items.name: Frame Shift
items.mechanism: apparent thesis about X revealed as a thesis about how we discuss X

items.name: Delayed Referent
items.mechanism: an abstract phrase used early acquires its referent late; the thesis snaps into focus retroactively

items.name: Convergence
items.mechanism: two independent argumentative lines converge; the thesis is the intersection point, stated once

items.name: Erosion Reversal
items.mechanism: the passage seems to erode a claim; the ending reveals the erosion was to expose its survivable core

items.name: Stated, Then Tested
items.mechanism: the central claim is stated flatly in the first two sentences; each later paragraph tests it against a case, and the close says how much of it survived

items.name: Paradox Up Front
items.mechanism: the passage opens on a claim that sounds self-contradictory and spends its length showing the claim is literally true

items.name: Received View Named First
items.mechanism: the first paragraph states what is usually believed and signals doubt; the passage's own position is the correction, visible in outline from paragraph one and in full by the middle
